Head: `4e1fe298643f1aee6fea79c9bb2c9275b53e0a26`

Tree: `0fe5ce934ca78082fb8b6c349bf743178c872f32`

This repair performs a third direct exact-line adjudication of all 256 score-owning parts after reopening all 254 authenticated MS originals at original detail. It removes fail-open route defaults, preserves every directly supported primary/alternative method in printed order, dispatches Energy and Newton instances through the exact method/topology model, derives all observed foreign candidate families, and binds candidate support to the family of its specifically referenced approved core. The four cumulative artifacts were regenerated deterministically; all required hard-gate counters remain zero and the exact P4-06 denominator remains zero.

The PR body now reports the current authority window verbatim (`2026-07-29T20:28:09Z` to `2026-07-29T20:30:13Z`, 124 seconds / 3 minutes), separately reports cumulative `visual_review_minutes=837`, and states the later third direct audit without inventing timestamps or access events.

Verification: 111/111 focused tests pass (producer 30, harness 27, P4-01 10, P4-02 9, P4-03 12, P4-04 14, P4-05 9); deterministic rebuild, physical-corpus authentication, Python compile, local backend/platform ESLint, and `git diff --check` pass. All five prior inline blockers have replies and are resolved.

Live GitHub lint jobs remain infrastructure-blocked: the self-hosted checkouts report missing `eslint.config.js` and `artifacts/lint/lint-baseline.json`, while GitHub contents for both the exact head and merge SHA contain those tracked blobs. ### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/Samsen879/ciecopilot-home/blob/4e1fe298643f1aee6fea79c9bb2c9275b53e0a26/scripts/vlm/issue_1776_p4_energy_semantic_kg.py#L395 **![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat) Enumerate all connected questions before falling back** Fresh evidence after the repair is `qrow_9709_w20_qp_41_q06`: its checked-in authority explicitly describes a car and trailer connected by a rigid tow-bar, with an Energy route for `q06/a` and a Newton route for `q06/b`, but the question is still absent from `CONNECTED_QUESTIONS`. This fallback consequently emits `apply_work_energy` and `apply_newtons_second_law` instead of the connected-system models, so the prior incomplete-topology issue remains for current-authority records. --- https://github.com/Samsen879/ciecopilot-home/blob/4e1fe298643f1aee6fea79c9bb2c9275b53e0a26/scripts/vlm/issue_1776_p4_energy_semantic_kg.py#L418 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Distinguish single vehicles from coupled vehicle systems** When a vehicle-classified question has a Newton route but no coupled component, this mapping still selects `solve_vehicle_coupling_newton_system`, whose definition requires a complete vehicle system and a visibly coupled component. For example, the repaired head emits that model for the cyclist-only `qrow_9709_w24_qp_42_q03::q03/a`; the checked-in authority describes only cyclist power, resistance, and hill inclination. These single-vehicle Newton routes need the single-body model rather than the coupling model. --- https://github.com/Samsen879/ciecopilot-home/blob/4e1fe298643f1aee6fea79c9bb2c9275b53e0a26/scripts/vlm/issue_1776_p4_energy_semantic_kg.py#L412 **![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat) Dispatch work-over-time power routes separately** Whenever the observed `power` method is the work-over-time relation rather than instantaneous `P = Fv`, this unconditional dispatch emits the wrong procedure. For example, `qrow_9709_m20_qp_42_q01::q01/a` asks for power from 750000 J of work done in 10 s, yet the generated instance is `relate_power_force_speed` and claims visible instantaneous speed and driving force; `qrow_9709_m22_qp_42_q01::q01/b` is similarly an average-power/time calculation. Add a work-over-time power definition and select it from the exact-part authority instead of treating every power route as vehicle force-speed. --- https://github.com/Samsen879/ciecopilot-home/blob/4e1fe298643f1aee6fea79c9bb2c9275b53e0a26/scripts/vlm/issue_1776_p4_energy_part_authority.json#L7074-L7078 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Bind review-batch metadata to the recorded access event** For this part, both `ms_review_batches` and `qp_review_batches` claim batch 2 while the adjacent access-event IDs claim `manual-rereview-batch-01`; the corresponding QP/MS entries in `image_access_ledger` also record `review_batch: 1`. This is not isolated—the same comparison finds mismatched batch metadata throughout the part authority—so consumers cannot reliably join a part's custody evidence to the immutable image-access ledger. Derive both fields from the same ledger records and add a cross-check. --- https://github.com/Samsen879/ciecopilot-home/blob/4e1fe298643f1aee6fea79c9bb2c9275b53e0a26/scripts/vlm/issue_1776_p4_energy_part_authority.json#L7099 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Store the exact mark-scheme section for each part** The `ms_extracted_section` for `qrow_9709_s16_qp_41_q02::q02/i` contains only question 1's velocity-time graph and lift calculation, while this part asks for work against friction on a rough plane; the same unrelated excerpt is copied to `q02/ii` and `q02/iii`. Because the record labels this field `location_and_semantic_route_only_not_visual_review`, the exported authority supplies incorrect semantic-location evidence for all three score lines. Extract the question 2 section from the referenced MS pages instead of retaining the preceding question's text.
